bull_bear.body:
- Established SAP consulting practice with a multi-geography delivery footprint through subsidiaries in India, UAE, and Singapore.
- Long-standing corporate history (36th Annual Report) indicating operational continuity and client relationships.
bull_bear.title: Bull — competitive strengths

bull_bear.body:
- Concentrated revenue dependence on subsidiaries — Standalone revenue declined to Rs. 883.86 Lakhs while consolidated revenue surged to Rs. 5186.53 Lakhs, indicating heavy reliance on subsidiary performance; any operational or financial stress in key subsidiaries could materially impact consolidated results.
- Execution risk in scaling sales force and achieving growth targets — The future outlook targets consolidated revenue of Rs. 80.00 crores (approx. 54% YoY growth) through a renewed thrust with a larger sales force; failure to recruit, train, or deploy this sales force effectively could lead to missed targets and cost overruns.
- Uncertainty in collection of partly paid-up share capital — 30,91,222 equity shares remain partly paid-up due to non-payment of call monies; while a final opportunity was provided, non-receipt could lead to forfeiture, dilution, or legal disputes, impacting capital structure and investor confidence.
- Margin pressure from rising financial costs — Consolidated financial cost increased from Rs. 87.90 Lakhs to Rs. 166.17 Lakhs, nearly doubling YoY; sustained increase in interest burden could erode profitability, especially if revenue growth does not compensate proportionately.
- Standalone operational losses and negative profitability — Standalone loss after tax of Rs. 77.49 Lakhs and negative EBITDA trend (Rs. 176.94 Lakhs vs. Rs. 642.96 Lakhs) highlight structural weakness in the parent entity; persistent losses may strain liquidity and limit ability to support subsidiaries.
bull_bear.title: Bear — key risks

business.body: Adroit Infotech Limited provides information technology services and solutions, primarily centered on SAP consulting, implementation, and support. The company operates through a consolidated structure with key revenue-generating subsidiaries in India and overseas, catering to enterprise clients seeking digital transformation. The standalone entity in Hyderabad acts as the parent, while subsidiaries drive the majority of consolidated operations.
